details.effect: Ward. [fanfare] Select up to 2 [havencraft] followers that cost 2 or less in your cemetery and summon them. While this card is on your field, each [havencraft] follower on your field has Rush. [act] Banish 3 [havencraft] followers from your cemetery: Give each other follower on your field [attack]+1/[defense]+1. Activate only once per turn.

issues: Fanfare summon is encoded with `maxTotalCost: 2`, but the text says 'Select up to 2 Havencraft followers that cost 2 or less in your cemetery and summon them.' Remove `maxTotalCost`; each selected follower only needs individual `maxCost: 2` with count 2.
Rush aura is encoded with `trait: "Havencraft"`, but Havencraft is a class, not a trait. It should grant Rush to each Havencraft follower on your field by using `cardClass: "haven"` instead.

Activated cost is encoded incorrectly. The banish-from-cemetery cost should use the implemented cost shape `banishFromCemetery` with a `filter` and `count`, e.g. `{ "banishFromCemetery": { "filter": { "cardClass": "haven", "cardType": "follower" }, "count": 3 } }`.

Activated buff targets are wrong. The text says 'Give each other follower on your field +1/+1,' not each other Havencraft follower. Encode the effect so it buffs all other followers on your field, not class-limited followers.

details.effect: [quick] Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 3 damage. If there is a Raio, Omen of Truth on your field, deal 6 damage to the selected follower and 3 damage to its leader instead.

issues: Raio mode is encoded without selecting the enemy follower target. The card says to deal 6 damage to the selected follower and 3 damage to its leader instead. Encode the Raio branch so it includes the selected enemy follower target for the 6 damage plus 3 to that follower's leader.

details.effect: [evolve] [cost02]: Evolve this follower. [fanfare] Each opponent buries the top 2 cards of their deck. Then, if there are at least 10 cards in opponents' cemeteries, evolve this follower.

issues: Fanfare is split into two separate abilities, but the text is sequential: each opponent buries the top 2 cards of their deck, then if there are at least 10 cards in opponents' cemeteries, evolve this follower. Encode this as one `fanfare` ability using `sequence` with `millOpponent` followed by an `if` check.
The auto-evolve clause is redundantly gated twice. Replace the current second fanfare ability with an `if` effect inside the single fanfare sequence whose `then` evolves this follower.
Auto-evolve is encoded with `triggerOnEvolve: true`, which is not part of the source text. Remove that flag unless required for a distinct printed clause.
